name: SIQ - Video Card Gallery
description: Modular video card gallery with hover-to-preview, masonry-style grid, and editorial design. Each card features video with poster, hover playback preview, glassmorphism overlay, tag/category badges, and expandable detail overlay. Supports Shopify hosted video, YouTube/Vimeo embeds, and MP4 URLs. Features autoplay-on-hover, custom grid columns, card radius, aspect ratio control, ambient glow, and scroll-reveal animations. 60+ customization options.
author: SectionIQ
